snippet.title: Ithya: Magic Studies - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330250/Ithya_Magic_Studies/

Ithya is a wandering mage, she arrives in the city of Oltak where she will be able to continue her studies. The city is old and crumbling but also lively and full of secrets.

Ithya: Magic Study is a cozy background app combined with productivity tools. Customize your room and relax with lofi or fantasy playlists in beautiful, hand-drawn environments. 
Perfect for a focused or creative session in a magical world.

Key features
🏡 A Customizable room
🎹 10 Playlists, from cozy Lofi to epic fantasy soundtrack 
🎨 Beautiful, hand-drawn animated environments and characters
🎯 Focused session with productivity tools (timer, pomodoro, to do list, journal)
🔥 10 Elementals to find

Release Date: May 7th, 2025

Created by Blue Turtle
https://linktr.ee/blueturtle_design

Trailer Music by @Carlonec 


#indiegame #fantasymusic #cozygames
